rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The case's return is married filing separately (job input f1040.status mfs, with household.married no), and the model followed i8962 p. 10, Column (f), "Not an applicable taxpayer. If you are not an applicable taxpayer because you are using filing status married filing separately and Exception 2, earlier, does not apply to you, you cannot take the PTC ... enter -0- on line 24, and enter the amount from line 11, column (f), on lines 25 and 27". That is the source's reading for a separate return, but a separate return is outside the tool (forms/2025/f8962.yaml note, "married filing separately is refused for the whole return"; s3.mfs, i1040gi p. 14): executed on the job's inputs, scope.ready, f1040.line33 and f1040.line37 are refused at s3.mfs, so no completed return shows this Form 8962. The project's line 24 ($4,668.00, the smaller of the column (a) and (d) totals) is the computation for a filer who is an applicable taxpayer. Class M jobs that pick a separate return measure nothing the tool prepares.

Ruling: model error; i8962 p. 8, Table 1-1, Federal Poverty Line for the 48 Contiguous States and the District of Columbia, "IF your family size* from Form 8962, line 1, was . . . THEN enter the amount below on Form 8962, line 4": the row for a family of 1 is $15,060 and the row for a family of 2 is $20,440. Line 1 is 2 on this case (both sides agree) and the table is the contiguous-states one (f8962.fpl_table), so line 4 is $20,440, the project's value. The model's $15,060 is the row for a family of 1, and its work says only "placeholder". Line 5 and every later line of the case agree. The fixture expectation is the model's value; dropped.
